title: Plans You Can Check: Verifier-Grounded Learning of an Open-Weight Planner for Executable Video-Editing
abstract: arXiv:2608.25622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practical video editing is not only pixel generation: an editor must turn a brief, a clip pool, music metadata, and hard constraints into an executable timeline. We study this decision layer as \emph{executable video-editing planning} and introduce RefineCut, which, unlike workflow systems that wrap a prompted frontier model, trains a compact open-weight planner for it. The planner edits a typed timeline through structured patches covering clip selection, trimming, ordering, transitions, and duration and music alignment; a deterministic verifier applies each patch and checks it against an explicit constraint ledger. Because editing has no single ground-truth repair, we do not imitate teachers directly: RefineCut replays every multi-teacher branch through the verifier and keeps verifier-best repairs as supervision. translated_title: 可核查的计划：基于验证器引导的开放权重规划器用于可执行视频编辑学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25622v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：实际视频编辑不仅仅是像素生成：编辑者必须将简报、片段池、音乐元数据和硬约束转化为可执行的时间线。我们将这一决策层视为“可执行视频编辑规划”，并引入RefineCut，与包装提示前沿模型的工作流系统不同，它训练了一个紧凑的开放权重规划器。该规划器通过结构化补丁编辑类型化时间线，涵盖片段选择、修剪、排序、转场、时长和音乐对齐；一个确定性验证器应用每个补丁并对照显式约束账本进行检查。由于编辑没有单一的真实修复，我们不直接模仿教师：RefineCut通过验证器重放每个多教师分支，并保留验证器最佳修复作为监督。第二阶段，RefineCut-Evo，让学生使用验证器和任务评分标准对自己的修复进行评分，并在高质量修复上训练。
tldr: 本文提出了RefineCut，一个通过验证器引导学习训练紧凑开放权重规划器的方法，用于生成可执行视频编辑时间线，并通过重放多教师分支和评分来克服缺乏单一真实修复的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces RefineCut, a method that trains a compact open-weight planner via verifier-guided learning to generate executable video-editing timelines, overcoming the lack of single ground-truth repairs by replaying multi-teacher branches and scoring.
